entities.summary: Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen is a Danish businessman who was the president and chief executive officer of the Lego Group from 1979 to 2004. According to Forbes, Kristiansen has an estimated net worth of US$6.8 billion as of December 2025. He is the grandson of Lego founder Ole Kirk Christiansen.
